verdict.rationale: Ollama is an LLM inference runtime, so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair serving-performance question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents splitting prefill and decode phases across workers or nodes. Concurrent model execution and dedicated cloud capacity are adjacent throughput features, not disaggregation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
